title: Measure receiver streaming resource limits
description:
Measure processing time, memory, buffering and sample I/O for the approved offline receiver on one declared host. Assess the changes and resource bounds required for streaming. Separate tuning span and channel count from the actual volume of samples and demodulation work.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use only lrfhss.09-approved code/tools/data and the ground-truth corpus. This unit performs no live hardware input, purchases or external communication. Report unsuitable resource requirements or no-go instead of silently narrowing the evidence workload.
acceptance_criteria: Time per second of independently timed samples, peak memory and dropped/backlogged work are reproducible. Sustained bounded execution is required for a real-time claim. An offline MATLAB result cannot establish MCU feasibility, 50-100 simultaneous links or arbitrary full-band reception.
